origin.description: Turns tagged and user-defined missing values into plain NA.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A labelled vector or a data frame.

origin.details: Labels attached to missing values are dropped. An SPSS column becomes an ordinary labelled vector.
origin.value: The vector or data frame with plain missing values.

translation.description: Turns tagged and user-defined missing values into plain NA.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A labelled vector or a data frame.

translation.details: Labels attached to missing values are dropped. An SPSS column becomes an ordinary labelled vector.
translation.value: The vector or data frame with plain missing values.
translation.example:
from haven import labelled_spss, zap_missing
x = labelled_spss([1, 2, 9], {"a": 1}, na_values=[9])
z = zap_missing(x)
print(z.values, z.class_)
